这是一个可交互的合成数学示例：改变斜率 `a`、偏移 `b` 或开关后，结果、曲线和表格都会立即重新计算。**合成数学示例数据**（所有数值均为演示用。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,result,chart,table,ask,reset])
$a: number = 2
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
form = Form(children=[aInput,bInput,toggle], title="参数")
aInput = Slider(label="斜率 a", bind=$a, min=-5, max=5, step=0.1)
bInput = NumberField(label="偏移 b", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset, step=0.1)
toggle = Switch(label="启用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x = 5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u")
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], xLabel="x", yLabel="y（u）", unit="u", title="合成数学示例：y = a·x + (useOffset ? b : 0)")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y（u）"}])
ask = Button(label="生成解释草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请解释这组参数下 y = a·x + (useOffset ? b : 0) 的行为与 x = 5 时的结果。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="重置为默认值", action=Reset())
```

说明：`ask` 会先校验表单，再把你当前的 `a`、`b`、`useOffset`、`yAt5` 冻结为一条可编辑的草稿，**不会自动发送**；`reset` 只在本地恢复默认值。
